import pandas as pd

# Load data
data = {
    "date": [20241231, 20241220, 20241219, 20241218, 20241208],
    "sender_acc": [1234567890, 2345678901, 3456789012, 4567890123, 5678901234],
    "fraud_type": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Filter data for 2024 and fraud type 1
df_2024 = df[(df['date'] >= 20240101) & (df['date'] <= 20241231) & (df['fraud_type'] == 1)]

# Group by sender_acc and count
grouped_df = df_2024.groupby('sender_acc').size().reset_index(name='count')

# Sort by count in descending order and get top 5
top_5 = grouped_df.sort_values(by='count', ascending=False).head(5)

print(top_5)

import pandas as pd

# Load data
data = {
    "date": [20241231, 20241220, 20241219, 20241218, 20241208],
    "sender_acc": [1234567890, 2345678901, 3456789012, 4567890123, 5678901234],
    "fraud_type": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Filter data for 2024 and fraud type 1
df_2024 = df[(df['date'] >= 20240101) & (df['date'] <= 20241231) & (df['fraud_type'] == 1)]

# Group by sender_acc and count
grouped_df = df_2024.groupby('sender_acc').size().reset_index(name='count')

# Sort by count in descending order and get top 5
top_5 = grouped_df.sort_values(by='count', ascending=False).head(5)

print(top_5)
